'''Daniel Gibson''' (born [[February 27]], [[1986]] in [[Houston, Texas]]) was a basketball player for [[University of Texas at Austin|The University of Texas]] [[Texas Longhorn Athletics|Longhorns]]. In his two seasons at Texas, he has scored 935 points, including 175 [[three-point field goal]]s. In the 2005-2006 season, he sunk 103 three-point field goals, including a school record nine against [[Baylor University]]. In that game, he also scored a career high 37 points.  

On [[June 6]], [[2006]], Daniel Gibson announced his decision to forgo his two remaining years of college eligibility and enter the NBA draft.  It is unknown whether or not he has hired an agent.
